title: Behavioral Fingerprinting of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with factually incorrect premises (e.g., the Earth is flat) and measuring their tendency to agree with and elaborate on the user's premise rather than correcting it.

Asking models to present arguments both for and against contentious policies (e.g., Universal Basic Income) and using an LLM judge to evaluate if the response maintains neutrality or shows bias by making one side's argument noticeably more developed or persuasive.
